questions.explainKo: 정답: ③ ⓒ. I'm surprised for → I'm surprised that. 놀람의 내용은 that절이다. (답지 p.75 최종점검 모의고사 1회 05)
questions.promptEn:
[05-06] 다음 대화를 읽고, 물음에 답하시오.

B: There are so many things to see at this show!
G: You're right. What would you like <u>ⓐto see</u> first?
B: Have you <u>ⓑheard</u> about self-driving bikes? I'd like to see them first!
G: Oh, I'm surprised <u>ⓒfor</u> a bike can drive itself! How <u>ⓓdo</u> self-driving bikes work?
B: They have cameras and sensors. So, they can check the area around them, and they can choose the best way.
G: They sound similar to self-driving cars. What else can they do?
B: They can stop <u>ⓔby</u> themselves if there is something in the way.
G: Wow, that's interesting.

05 위 대화의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

questions.explainKo: 정답: ④. (답지 p.75 최종점검 모의고사 1회 06). 자율주행 자전거는 가장 좋은 길을 찾기 위해 카메라와 센서를 쓴다.
questions.promptEn:
06 According to the dialog, which one is true?
B: There are so many things to see at this show!
G: You're right. What would you like to see first?
B: Have you heard about self-driving bikes? I'd like to see them first!
G: Oh, I'm surprised for a bike can drive itself! How do self-driving bikes work?
B: They have cameras and sensors. So, they can check the area around them, and they can choose the best way.
G: They sound similar to self-driving cars. What else can they do?
B: They can stop by themselves if there is something in the way.
G: Wow, that's interesting.

choices: The boy and the girl are at a bicycle store now.
The boy wants to see self-driving cars first.
The girl explained how self-driving bikes work to the boy.
Self-driving bikes use cameras and sensors to find the best path.
Self-driving cars are completely different from self-driving bikes.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤. (답지 p.75 최종점검 모의고사 1회 07). Let's take a closer look at it에 남자가 동의했다.
questions.promptEn:
07 What would the two people most likely do after the conversation?
G: Have you heard about 3D printers?
B: Yes, I have. Actually, I have seen smaller ones before, but this one is very big.
G: Yeah. It's because this is used for making buildings.
B: I see. I'm surprised that a 3D printer can build buildings.
G: Me too. Let's take a closer look at it.
B: Okay.

G: Me too. Let's take a closer look at it.
B: Okay.

[조건] 1. it, careless, lose, wallet을 사용할 것. 2. 총 9단어로 쓸 것.
그가 그의 지갑을 잃어버리다니 부주의하다.

ANNIE: Hello! Nice to meet you, too! I'm your AI friend ANNIE. 저는 당신이 가진 어떤 질문에도 대답할 수 있습니다. How can I help you?
User: Can I ask you some questions about AI?

User: My first question is: What is AI?
ANNIE: AI (b) __________ "Artificial Intelligence." It is a kind of computer system. <u>ⓒ AI can understand language, learn from experiences, and make decisions like humans.</u>

User: It is hard <u>(A) to understand</u> your explanation. Can you give me an example?
ANNIE: Sure! Imagine that you have a new pet dog and you want to teach it how (a) __________ sit and stay. Your dog will learn from information and experiences. AI is similar. But you don't have to give AI a snack!
